name: io.github.Clawdio777/aeonos
description: AI search visibility MCP. Checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude name a site.

environmentVariables.name: AEONOS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AEONOS API key (pg_...) from a card credit purchase at https://aeonos.basechainlabs.com/#get-access. Calls go to the hosted endpoint with this key in X-Api-Key and are charged to your credits. Used instead of AEONOS_PRIVATE_KEY when both are set.

environmentVariables.name: AEONOS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base wallet private key (0x...) to pay per call in USDC on Base via x402, signed on your machine. Per-call: 0.05 (query), 0.50 (schema/llms-txt), 1.50 (progress), 2.50 USDC (audit). Set this or AEONOS_API_KEY.
